sections.title: Minimum description length, coding precision and model selection

missing_pieces.duty: assessment_dispute: ED26-METHOD-minimum-description-length-C02 partial: the body never states the selection rule. Nowhere does it say that the estimated structure (n,m) is the minimizer of U_R, or of the constant-retaining surrogate, over the candidate orders. Source eq. (4.10) on p.471 states this ('to be minimized with respect to the structure parameters n and m'). The method at rissanen-structural-and-numerical-inference.tex l.290-298 says only 'Compare the published score'.

assessment_dispute: ED26-METHOD-minimum-description-length-C03 partial: the estimation conclusions are not written as rules. The source says the xi_i are determined to minimize the profiled length (4.6) on p.470; the body has only 'fit ... using the declared length surrogate' (l.292-293) and a 'stationary fit' (l.230). The structural estimate as the argmin of (4.10) over (n,m) is also missing.

assessment_dispute: MP-0 partial: the MDL method, coding precision and the separation from Occam are now on route (Rissanen chapter l.100-362; annex l.108-219). The model-selection presentation still lacks the explicit minimization or selection rule (see C02/C03).

assessment_dispute: All 12 ED26-P15-CH-occam-learning components are covered (occam-learning.tex body l.13-273, annex l.4-295; Blumer et al. 1987 checked at pp.378, 379 and 380). ED26-METHOD-minimum-description-length C01, C04 and C05 are covered.
